verses.text_en: And it came to pass upon the third day, I sat under an oak, and, behold, there came a voice out of a bush over against me, and said, Esdras, Esdras.
verses.text_hr: Trećega dana sjedio sam pod hrastom. I gle, iz grma nasuprot meni začuo se glas: Ezra, Ezra!

verses.text_en: And I said, Here am I, Lord And I stood up upon my feet.
verses.text_hr: Rekao sam: Evo me, Gospodine. I ustao sam na noge.

verses.text_en: Then said he unto me, In the bush I did manifestly reveal myself unto Moses, and talked with him, when my people served in Egypt:
verses.text_hr: Tada mi je rekao: U grmu sam se jasno objavio Mojsiju i razgovarao s njim dok je moj narod služio u Egiptu.

verses.text_en: And I sent him and led my people out of Egypt, and brought him up to the mount of where I held him by me a long season,
verses.text_hr: Poslao sam ga, izveo svoj narod iz Egipta i doveo Mojsija na goru, gdje sam ga dugo držao uza se.

verses.text_en: And told him many wondrous things, and shewed him the secrets of the times, and the end; and commanded him, saying,
verses.text_hr: Govorio sam mu o mnogim čudesnim stvarima, pokazao mu tajne vremena i svršetka te mu zapovjedio:

verses.text_en: These words shalt thou declare, and these shalt thou hide.
verses.text_hr: Ove riječi ćeš objaviti, a ove ćeš sakriti.

verses.text_en: And now I say unto thee,
verses.text_hr: A sada ti kažem,

verses.text_en: That thou lay up in thy heart the signs that I have shewed, and the dreams that thou hast seen, and the interpretations which thou hast heard:
verses.text_hr: Pohrani u srce znakove koje sam ti pokazao, snove koje si vidio i tumačenja koja si čuo.

verses.text_en: For thou shalt be taken away from all, and from henceforth thou shalt remain with my Son, and with such as be like thee, until the times be ended.
verses.text_hr: Jer ćeš biti uzet od svih, i od sada ćeš ostati s mojim Sinom, i sa onima koji su tebi slični, do kraja vremena.

verses.text_en: For the world hath lost his youth, and the times begin to wax old.
verses.text_hr: Jer svijet je izgubio mladost, a vremena počinju stariti.

verses.text_en: For the world is divided into twelve parts, and the ten parts of it are gone already, and half of a tenth part:
verses.text_hr: Svijet je podijeljen na dvanaest dijelova; deset i polovica desetoga dijela već su prošli.

verses.text_en: And there remaineth that which is after the half of the tenth part.
verses.text_hr: Preostaje ono što dolazi nakon polovice desetoga dijela.

verses.text_en: Now therefore set thine house in order, and reprove thy people, comfort such of them as be in trouble, and now renounce corruption,
verses.text_hr: Zato sada uredi svoju kuću, ukori svoj narod, utješi one koji su u nevolji i odreci se raspadljivosti.

verses.text_en: Let go from thee mortal thoughts, cast away the burdens of man, put off now the weak nature,
verses.text_hr: Otpusti od sebe smrtne misli, odbaci ljudska bremena i svuci slabu narav.

verses.text_en: And set aside the thoughts that are most heavy unto thee, and haste thee to flee from these times.
verses.text_hr: Ostavi po strani misli koje te najviše opterećuju i požuri pobjeći iz ovih vremena.

verses.text_en: For yet greater evils than those which thou hast seen happen shall be done hereafter.
verses.text_hr: Jer još veća zla od onih koja si vidio da se događaju dogodit će se poslije.

verses.text_en: For look how much the world shall be weaker through age, so much the more shall evils increase upon them that dwell therein.
verses.text_hr: Koliko svijet zbog starosti bude slabio, toliko će se više umnažati zla među njegovim stanovnicima.

verses.text_en: For the time is fled far away, and leasing is hard at hand: for now hasteth the vision to come, which thou hast seen.
verses.text_hr: Vrijeme je već daleko odmaklo, a laž je nadohvat ruke; viđenje koje si vidio sada se žurno približava.

verses.text_en: Then answered I before thee, and said,
verses.text_hr: Tada sam pred tobom odgovorio:

verses.text_en: Behold, Lord, I will go, as thou hast commanded me, and reprove the people which are present: but they that shall be born afterward, who shall admonish them? thus the world is set in darkness, and they that dwell therein are without light.
verses.text_hr: Gle, Gospodine, poći ću kako si mi zapovjedio i ukoriti sadašnji narod. Ali tko će opomenuti one koji će se poslije roditi? Svijet je u tami, a njegovi stanovnici bez svjetla.

verses.text_en: For thy law is burnt, therefore no man knoweth the things that are done of thee, or the work that shall begin.
verses.text_hr: Tvoj je Zakon spaljen; zato nitko ne zna što si učinio ni djelo koje će započeti.

verses.text_en: But if I have found grace before thee, send the Holy Ghost into me, and I shall write all that hath been done in the world since the beginning, which were written in thy law, that men may find thy path, and that they which will live in the latter days may live.
verses.text_hr: Ali ako sam našao milost pred tobom, pošalji u mene Duha Svetoga. Zapisat ću sve što je od početka učinjeno u svijetu i što je bilo zapisano u tvojemu Zakonu, kako bi ljudi pronašli tvoj put i kako bi mogli živjeti oni koji će živjeti u posljednje dane.

verses.text_en: And he answered me, saying, Go thy way, gather the people together, and say unto them, that they seek thee not for forty days.
verses.text_hr: Odgovorio mi je: Idi, okupi narod i reci mu da te ne traži četrdeset dana.

verses.text_en: But look thou prepare thee many box trees, and take with thee Sarea, Dabria, Selemia, Ecanus, and Asiel, these five which are ready to write swiftly;
verses.text_hr: Pripravi mnogo pločica od šimširova drva i povedi Sareju, Dabriju, Selemiju, Ekana i Asiela, ovu petoricu spremnu brzo pisati.

verses.text_en: And come hither, and I shall light a candle of understanding in thine heart, which shall not be put out, till the things be performed which thou shalt begin to write.
verses.text_hr: Dođi ovamo, a ja ću u tvojemu srcu zapaliti svjetiljku razumijevanja koja se neće ugasiti dok ne dovršiš ono što ćeš početi pisati.

verses.text_en: And when thou hast done, some things shalt thou publish, and some things shalt thou shew secretly to the wise: to morrow this hour shalt thou begin to write.
verses.text_hr: Kad završiš, nešto ćeš javno objaviti, a nešto potajno pokazati mudrima. Sutra u ovo doba počet ćeš pisati.

verses.text_en: Then went I forth, as he commanded, and gathered all the people together, and said,
verses.text_hr: Tada sam izišao, kako je zapovjedio, okupio sav narod i rekao:

verses.text_en: Hear these words, O Israel.
verses.text_hr: Čuj ove riječi, Izraele.

verses.text_en: Our fathers at the beginning were strangers in Egypt, from whence they were delivered:
verses.text_hr: Naši su očevi u početku bili stranci u Egiptu, odakle su izbavljeni:

verses.text_en: And received the law of life, which they kept not, which ye also have transgressed after them.
verses.text_hr: Primili su Zakon života, ali ga nisu čuvali; nakon njih i vi ste ga prekršili.

verses.text_en: Then was the land, even the land of Sion, parted among you by lot: but your fathers, and ye yourselves, have done unrighteousness, and have not kept the ways which the Highest commanded you.
verses.text_hr: Tada vam je ždrijebom razdijeljena zemlja, sama zemlja Sion. Ali vaši su oci, kao i vi sami, činili nepravdu i nisu čuvali putove koje vam je Svevišnji zapovjedio.

verses.text_en: And forasmuch as he is a righteous judge, he took from you in time the thing that he had given you.
verses.text_hr: Budući da je pravedan sudac, u svoje vam je vrijeme oduzeo ono što vam je bio dao.

verses.text_en: And now are ye here, and your brethren among you.
verses.text_hr: I sada ste vi ovdje, i vaša braća među vama.

verses.text_en: Therefore if so be that ye will subdue your own understanding, and reform your hearts, ye shall be kept alive and after death ye shall obtain mercy.
verses.text_hr: Ako pokorite vlastiti razum i obnovite svoja srca, ostat ćete živi, a nakon smrti zadobit ćete milosrđe.

verses.text_en: For after death shall the judgment come, when we shall live again: and then shall the names of the righteous be manifest, and the works of the ungodly shall be declared.
verses.text_hr: Nakon smrti doći će sud, kada ćemo ponovno oživjeti. Tada će se objaviti imena pravednika i razotkriti djela bezbožnika.

verses.text_en: Let no man therefore come unto me now, nor seek after me these forty days.
verses.text_hr: Zato neka sada nitko ne dolazi k meni niti me traži ovih četrdeset dana.

verses.text_en: So I took the five men, as he commanded me, and we went into the field, and remained there.
verses.text_hr: Tako sam uzeo pet ljudi, kako mi je naredio, pa smo otišli u polje i ostali ondje.

verses.text_en: And the next day, behold, a voice called me, saying, Esdras, open thy mouth, and drink that I give thee to drink.
verses.text_hr: Sljedećega me dana pozvao glas: Ezra, otvori usta i pij ono što ti dajem.

verses.text_en: Then opened I my mouth, and, behold, he reached me a full cup, which was full as it were with water, but the colour of it was like fire.
verses.text_hr: Otvorio sam usta, i gle, pružio mi je punu čašu. Bila je puna nečega nalik vodi, ali boje poput ognja.

verses.text_en: And I took it, and drank: and when I had drunk of it, my heart uttered understanding, and wisdom grew in my breast, for my spirit strengthened my memory:
verses.text_hr: Uzeo sam je i popio. Kad sam popio, moje je srce izricalo razum, a u grudima mi je rasla mudrost, jer mi je duh ojačao pamćenje.

verses.text_en: And my mouth was opened, and shut no more.
verses.text_hr: Usta su mi se otvorila i više se nisu zatvorila.

verses.text_en: The Highest gave understanding unto the five men, and they wrote the wonderful visions of the night that were told, which they knew not: and they sat forty days, and they wrote in the day, and at night they ate bread.
verses.text_hr: Svevišnji je petorici ljudi dao razum i oni su zapisivali čudesna noćna viđenja koja su im bila kazivana, premda ih nisu poznavali. Sjedili su četrdeset dana, danju pisali, a noću jeli kruh.

verses.text_en: As for me. I spake in the day, and I held not my tongue by night.
verses.text_hr: Ja sam govorio danju, a ni noću nisam šutio.

verses.text_en: In forty days they wrote two hundred and four books.
verses.text_hr: Za četrdeset dana napisali su dvije stotine četiri knjige.

verses.text_en: And it came to pass, when the forty days were filled, that the Highest spake, saying, The first that thou hast written publish openly, that the worthy and unworthy may read it:
verses.text_hr: Kad se navršilo četrdeset dana, Svevišnji je rekao: Prve knjige koje si napisao javno objavi, kako bi ih mogli čitati dostojni i nedostojni.

verses.text_en: But keep the seventy last, that thou mayest deliver them only to such as be wise among the people:
verses.text_hr: Ali posljednjih sedamdeset sačuvaj kako bi ih predao samo mudrima među narodom.

verses.text_en: For in them is the spring of understanding, the fountain of wisdom, and the stream of knowledge.
verses.text_hr: Jer u njima je izvor razumijevanja, vrelo mudrosti i potok znanja.

verses.text_en: And I did so.
verses.text_hr: I učinio sam to.
